summary: Completed frontend smoke and integration testing across desktop and mobile. Auth validation, all demo roles, refresh persistence, logout, dashboard, five Kanban stages, search, task creation, stage movement toast, task detail, notification popover/page, and responsive rendering passed. Backend is not connected to this MVP and /api/health returns 404.

critical.issue: Returns 404; server has no registered API routes. Auth, task persistence, comments, notifications, and board data are not API-backed.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile menu button is rendered but has no onClick behavior, so the hidden sidebar cannot be opened on mobile.

integration_issues.issue: Comment input and button are present, but clicking Comment does not save a comment, update the count, or show feedback.
Mark all read button has no handler and unread badge/items never change.
Dashboard greeting is hardcoded to Jordan even after Board Master or Member demo sign-in.

action_items: Connect authentication and workspace entities to the backend API (or clearly scope the demo as mocked).
Implement comment submission and persistence/count updates.
Implement mark-all-read/unread badge state and notification persistence.
Make mobile menu open/close the sidebar and use the current user name in dashboard copy.
critical_code_review_comments: Most controls are visual placeholders: board filter, timeline/activity tabs, board settings, add board, member menus, workload details, and convert-to-subtask do not perform actions.
Task stage movement updates localStorage only; there is no server-side persistence or authorization by role.
seed_data_creation: Created one localStorage-only regression task named Regression task during browser testing; no server seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile smoke flow passed through demo auth, dashboard, board, task modal, search, create/move task, notifications, refresh, and logout. Re-test comment persistence, read state, mobile menu, role greeting, and API integration after fixes.
rca of the issue: Root cause is the MVP architecture in PRD/App.js: state and actions are local React/localStorage; several buttons are rendered without handlers. Backend server.py contains only the FastAPI app shell, so no API route exists.
